node.statement: Typed conclusions of the three allowed providers. Under 1.2, lem-stage1-explicit-group-domain-membership supplies its unique inverse (u_d,h_d) of the displayed Pi_delta and says every U bold-dot V and U^dagger lies in S_delta and has a right inverse. Under the same hypotheses, lem-stage1-explicit-group-closeness supplies its unique inverse (u_c,h_c) and the bounds ||u_c(U bold-dot V)-U bold-dot V||<=G_c*e and ||u_c(U^dagger)-U^dagger||<=G_c*e. Finally lem-stage1-polar-retraction supplies a C^1 diffeomorphism Pi_delta from calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) onto S_delta, with unique C^1 inverse (u_r,h_r), u_r(U)=U and h_r(U)=J for U in calU.
